comment: Epoch 64 of 1.3.0 (pending), EU5 1.4.7/build26377361; frozen epoch63 preserved in golden_world_epoch63.json. Wastelands are planned terrain, not the highest cells: dunes, plateaus, flat wilds under any vegetation, hills and mountains, chosen from the climate and vegetation just drawn, at the sea as inland, and sized from the vanilla impassable locations (rnw.barrens), and named for their terrain (a Highlands, a Wilds, a Desert). They are decided before the coasts, so the ports, docks and strait crossings are made for the land they leave passable. The active coasts raise cordilleras; the rivers are drawn before the land cells, which take the larger rivers as borders and are seeded as far apart as the game's locations of the class the climate vote will choose; the vote learns from the Americas too, without farmland; hills are the cells whose height bends most. The location templates, the hierarchy, the localization in all eleven languages and the files that draw them change; the count stays 884.
